Commentary.Commentary: Right then! This brings an end to England's tour of India. They lost the 4-match Test series by a margin of 3-1. Then the white-ball leg started and England played a good T20I series but still ended on the losing side this time by a margin of 3-2. The last part of the tour was the ODIs and England almost had their hand on the trophy but once again ended on the losing side by 2-1. India skipper, Virat Kohli takes the trophy now and poses for the shutterbugs with his team. We have had a complete dose of entertainment throughout the entire tour. We have a full dose of entertainment coming up. Yes, the most-loved Indian T20 League is back and this time at its home. The action begins on 9th April 2021 with the clash between Mumbai and Bangalore. We hope to have your company for that. Till then, cheers and take care.

Virat Kohli, the Indian skipper, says that when the top two teams battle each other, it usually provides games like these. Adds that Curran played really well but their bowlers kept taking wickets at regular intervals in the second innings. Adds that Natarajan and Hardik were brilliant to finish it off in the end. States that it is disappointing the most for the guys who drop the catches. Tells that sometimes the dropped catches cost you and sometimes, they don't. Adds that the important thing is crossing the line in the end. Tells that he was surprised that Shardul Thakur was not the Man of the Match and Bhuvneshwar and Shardul made the difference in this series. Goes onto say Prasidh was impressive and Krunal was good in the first game. Tells that he was pleased to see the depth of their batting. Tells that it has been an amazing season for them and they take away a lot from this season and they go into the Indian T20 league with a lot of experience. Tells that scheduling is something which needs to be looked at as being in a bubble for a long period of time is not ideal and he is sure that things will be discussed.

Jonny Bairstow, the MAN OF THE SERIES, says that he is pleased with how he struck the ball but is disappointed with the loss. Adds that it was nice to come back after a tough time in Tests and play well in the shorter formats. Says that Bhuvneshwar is a very good bowler and he knows something about him as they play in the same team in the Indian T20 League. Tells that Curran took the game deep and it was a special innings and he played out of his skins there. Says that Natarajan bowled extremely well in the final over. Tells that Curran executed his plans well and he timed it well.

Sam Curran, the MAN OF THE MATCH, says that he is happy with the way he played but is disappointed that they could now win. Adds that he has not played an innings like this and tells that he has gained some valuable experience. Tells that Natarajan bowled well in the final over and he showed how good a bowler he is. Tells that Bhuvneshwar is a great bowler. Says that he is learning and this was a great wicket and it has given him immense confidence. Adds that it is great playing cricket in India.

Jos Buttler, the England skipper, says that it was a fantastic game. Adds that both teams committed mistakes and played some great cricket as well. Tells that Sam Curran played an unbelievable knock. States that they are disappointed but there have been great learnings and white-leg tour has been very close. Goes onto say that they have gained valuable experiences and playing in India is also great learning. Tells that the guys will become much better cricketers after playing in India. Tells that it was a great wicket and it is hard to defend. Says that they dragged it back well in the end with the ball. Says that they never got big partnerships and that is what cost them. Adds that they are going from strength to strength and they have been playing some excellent cricket for a few years now. Tells that they are disappointed but Sam Curran showed some amazing maturity and he has gained some valuable experience from this knock.
Stay tuned for the presentation ceremony!

Bhuvneshwar Kumar now comes up. He says that being a bowler, they are always under pressure. Adds that they were prepared for anything. Goes onto say that he was ready to bowl the first over and he knew if he could bowl the inswinger, he could get the wicket. Tells that he is looking forward to the Indian T20 League.

Shikhar Dhawan is up for a chat. He says that he was always in the groove and once he got the chance, he made the most of it and it is a good feeling to bat like this. Says that he was playing domestic cricket and he played Syed Mushtaq Ali trophy and the Vijay Hazare trophy to prepare for this series. Adds that it was a true wicket and he enjoys playing on a bouncy wicket.

Earlier after being put to bat, the Indan openers started in full flow as they stitched a 103-run stand. England did manage to make a comeback with three quick wickets. And once again it was Rishabh Pant on whom India rested their hopes. He did not disappoint as he played a quickfire innings along with Hardik Pandya. Though both departed in quick succession and India, from a position of ascendancy, fell apart losing 4 wickets for 8 runs to get bowled out for 329 runs. With the ball for England, Mark Wood ended with 3 wickets as Rashid had a couple to his name. England used 7 bowlers and all of them were in the wickets column. India had their heart in their mouth as their score just proved enough to win.

India's bowling was exceptional from the start as they kept the English batsmen in check and picked wickets regularly. They were in a commanding position when England were reeling at 200/7. Then the stand between Curran and Adil Rashid first frustrated them and then Curran along with Mark Wood threatened to take the game away from them but they did hang around and finally came out with flying colours. It was Bhuvneshwar Kumar's two wickets at the start when he sent Roy and Bairstow, England's two batting mainstays. Then Shardul Thakur took it from him and ran riot in the English camp as he ended with yet another 4-wicket haul. The big boost for India though was Hardik the batsman, as well as the bowler, did a fair job. But as a fielder, he was off-colour as he dropped two catches. The rest of the bowlers though were taken for a hit but T Natarajan asked to bowl the final over held his nerves and won it for India. India though should have closed the game much earlier after having England on the mat but it was the fielding. No matter they plucked some good catches but dropped 4 catches which made them toil hard in the field till the end.

Just when India thought that they would wrap up the game quickly, Sam Curran had other ideas as he ran, cut, pulled, defended. He did all the things to keep England in the hunt and take them as close as possible to the Indian total. In the end, what you call experience is what he lacked and thus he could not finish off the game. This should just make him a mature player in the coming years. Not just Curran but all praises for Mark Wood. Despite suffering from dehydration while bowling, he hung around with Sam to stitch a 60-run stand for the 9th wicket. In the end, England fell short by a mere 7 runs.

Chasing a score of 330 runs, England needed a strong start which they got as Roy stroked 3 boundaries in Bhuvneshwar Kumar's first over before departing off a beauty. They still had the momentum on their side but a close LBW call off Jonny Bairstow snatched away the momentum from them. Stokes after being given a reprieve by Pandya failed to capitalise as he fell off a full toss. Buttler's poor form continued as he departed cheaply. Malan played a lone hand as he scored his maiden ODI fifty but could not continue for long. Liam Livingstone fell off a full toss too after getting a start. But Adil Rashid and Sam Curran continued to keep England in the hunt.

A game to remember for the ages to come. Take a bow, Sam Curran. Though England lost the game but Curran becomes a hero. Someone with such little experience has hung around to give India a run for their money. Back of a length ball on middle, Livingstone works it to mid-wicket.
Good length ball on off, Dawid guides it to third man for a single.
Short ball around off, Malan sways away from it.
Down the leg side, Malan looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Full on middle, Livingstone flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Liam Livingstone comes onto bat now.

Review taken by Kohli against Buttler for LBW. Let's see what the replays have to say. The Ultra Edge comes on and it shows a flat line when the ball passes the bat. Ball Tracker comes on and shows that it is THREE REDS! Buttler has to depart.

OUT! LBW! All reds it is and Buttler has to go! Big wicket for India as Buttler can be a dangerous batsman and he can take the game away in seconds. Good length ball on middle and leg, Buttler looks to defend but misses and gets rapped on the pads. India appeal but the umpire is not interested. Kohli takes the review after thinking for a while. The Ultra Edge shows nothing. What does the Ball Tracker say? It shows all reds and Buttler goes. What a use of review.
Length and around off, Buttler dabs it to cover-point for a single. 9 runs off Hardik Pandya's first over.
Length and around off, Malan runs it down to the third man region for a single.
Length and around off, Buttler taps it in front of covers and takes a quick single. Would have been close had Kohli hit at the non-striker's end.
Short and around middle, Malan goes for the pull but takes his eyes off the ball. He though does well to keep the ball on the ground. A single taken.
Length and angled on the pads, Buttler looks to clip it to the leg side but the ball goes off the pads for a leg bye.
FOUR! Welcome to the attack Hardik says Buttler! Short and wide from junior Pandya and Jos cuts it uppishly over backward point and gets a boundary.

Drinks! India have done well so far. They have managed to send back the in-form batsmen back to the hut and they are on top but they cannot afford to relax till the time, Buttler and Malan are at the crease. If they get these two, they will be on top. England, on the other hand, need this partnership to go big and get them closer to the total. Malan has looked good while Buttler has started off well. Can they make a big stand? Hardik Pandya is into the attack.
Good length and around off, Malan drives it through covers and gets a brace this time. England need 244 in 216 balls!
Length and on leg, Malan looks to fend it away to the leg side but gets beaten to get hit high on the thigh pad.
Length and around off, Buttler carves it through covers and takes a single on offer.
Length and around off, Buttler punches it to the off side.
FOUR! This should get Buttler on! Length and around off, Buttler just times his cover drive exquisitely and gets a boundary.
Length and around off, Malan pushes it to third man and takes a single.
Shardul Thakur is on now.
Length and around middle, clipped towards the leg side for a single.
Fuller and around off, Buttler pushes it to long off and rotates the strike.
Play and a miss! Full toss outside off, Buttler looks to drive it through the off side but fails to lay bat on ball.
Good length and around off again, Buttler cuts it but finds the fielder at point.
Good length and around off, Buttler pushes it off the front foot to the off side.
Fuller and around off, Buttler strokes it to short cover.
Length and around off, Malan pushes it off the back foot towards the off side.
Good length and around off, Buttler pushes it to the off side and takes a single.
Full and around middle, Buttler clips it to deep mid-wicket and takes a brace with ease.
Length and around off, Dawid cuts it past point for a single only.
FOUR! Carved! Length and outside off, Malan throws the bat at it as the ball flies past the backward point fielder and into the fence there for a boundary.
Play and a miss! Length and outside off, Malan looks to slash at it but is beaten on the outside edge.
Length and in line with the stumps, Jos pushes it down to mid on again. 2 runs and the all-important wicket of Stokes.
Slower off cutter from Natarajan and Buttler strokes it to point.
Length and around off, Buttler strokes it to mid on.
Jos Buttler makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! India bag the big, big wicket of Ben Stokes! Hardik would be a relieved man. A full toss on middle from Natarajan, Stokes skips down the track and looks to power it over deep mid-wicket. He though is not in a position to play at it as the ball takes the higher part of the bat. The ball goes in the air to deep square leg. Shikhar Dhawan there takes the catch. The third umpire is called for to check if it is a No Ball and after a few replays, the third umpire signals that it is a legal delivery as Stokes takes the long walk back.
Is it a No Ball for a full above the waist or is it a legal delivery? Let's see what happens.
Good length and around off, Stokes makes some room and looks to drive through covers but finds the fielder at covers to perfection.
Fuller and down the ground, Stokes uses his feet and drives it past Hardik at mid off. A brace taken as Krunal Pandya collects it.
Powerplay 2 time! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be stationed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. T Natarajan has a change of ends.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Short delivery on off, Malan cuts it hard through point for a boundary. ENGLAND ARE 66/2 AFTER POWERPLAY 1!
Good length delivery on off, Malan defends it to point.
Back of a length on off, Malan pushes it to point.
FOUR! Lovely shot! This will give Malan a lot of confidence! Length delivery on off, Malan drives it through covers for a boundary.
Length delivery on off, Stokes guides it towards third man for a single.
SIX! This was a nasty delivery but it has gone for a biggie! Short delivery on off, Stokes looks to pull but gets a top edge. It goes over third man for a maximum.
Just 1 from the over! Full ball on off, Malan pushes it to cover.
Full on off, Stokes defends it to cover for a single.
Fullish ball on middle, worked to mid-wicket.
On a length outside off, Stokes dances down the track and then punches it to mid off.
On a length on off, Stokes defends it to cover.
Good length ball on middle, defended back to the bowler.

Sharp single! This would have been close! Good length ball outside off, Stokes plays it to mid off and takes off for a run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Stokes would have been a goner if it had hit.
Short outside off, Stokes punches it to cover.
On a length on middle, Stokes plays it to mid on.
Short ball outside off, Stokes punches it to cover where Shikhar Dhawan fumbles, allowing the batters to pick up a couple of runs.
FOUR! Brilliant shot from Stokes! Back of a length ball outside off, Stokes hammers it through mid off for a boundary.
Prasidh Krishna is into the attack now.
What happened there? Good start from Prasidh Krishna! Short ball around off, Stokes is surprised by it and hops but still manages to fend it away.
Back of a length on middle, Stokes flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Stokes flicks it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length on middle, Stokes pushes it to mid on.
Length delivery on off, Malan pushes it towards point for a single.
Good length delivery on middle, Malan keeps it out.
Length delivery on off, Malan pushes it to covers.
Fullish on the pads, Dawid flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Fullish ball on the pads, Malan flicks it to mid-wicket.
On a length on off, Stokes defends it to cover and takes a quick run.
BEATEN! Wow, this is a superb delivery from Natarajan! Good length ball around off, it moves away. Stokes looks to defend but gets beaten.
WIDE! Good length ball down the leg side, Ben looks to flick but fails to get anything on it. Another wide.
Full on off, Stokes pushes it to mid off.
Good length ball on off, Stokes defends it to mid on.
WIDE! Full ball down the leg side, Stokes looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Good length and on the pads, Malan tucks it to the leg side.
Length and going across off, Malan makes a leave.

Chipped it high in the air... DROPPED! Who is it? Hardik Pandya. Length and around off, Stokes goes for a hit downtown but chips it in the air over the bowler's head. Krunal Pandya from mid on and Hardik Pandya from mid off converge to take the catch, Hardik calls for the catch and Krunal backs out. Hardik gets a hand to it but he cannot hold onto it. A single taken. How costly will this drop prove for India? Can Stokes capitalise on this lifeline?
Good length and around off, Stokes blocks it out to the off side.
Fuller length ball around off, Stokes pushes it back to the bowler.
Length and around middle, pushed down to mid on for a quick single by Malan.
FOUR! Almost another wicket! Short delivery on off, Stokes cuts it over point. It just goes over point for a boundary.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, Stokes looks to defend but misses it due to the outswing on this one.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Stokes looks to flick but misses it.
Length delivery on off, Malan guides it through point for a run.
Back of a length on off, Stokes pushes it towards point for a single.
Length ball outside off, Stokes offers no shot to this one.
Good length delivery on off, Stokes defends it off the back foot.
Dawid Malan comes out to bat.
Bairstow has been given out LBW and he has taken the review. The Ultra Edge shows nothing while the Ball Tracker shows that it is the umpire's call on hitting the stumps.

OUT! LBW! Umpire's call! Length and around off, coming in with the angle, Bairstow shuffles across the off pole and looks to clip it but he misses it and gets rapped on the pads. Kumar appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Bairstow takes the review after consulting his partner. The Ultra Edge comes on and it shows a flat line with the ball passes the bat. Ball Tracker comes on and shows that it is Umpire's call on hitting the wickets. England though retain the review but lose the all-important wicket of Jonny Bairstow.
Length and around off, Stokes cuts it to covers for a single.
FOUR! And a poor delivery and Stokes takes the toll. Length and around middle, Stokes chips it in the air over mid on and into the fence for a boundary.
Another fuller length ball around off, Stokes plays it off the front foot towards the bowler. Kumar is tight with his lines there.
Fuller length ball around off, Stokes is solid in defence this time.
WIDE! Length and down leg, Stokes looks to flick it but misses it. Wide called.
Length and around off, Stokes blocks it out to the off side.
Length delivery on off, Stokes looks to defend but gets an outside edge. It goes towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Short delivery on off, Stokes punches it through covers for a boundary.
Full on middle, Stokes flicks it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length on middle, Bairstow flicks it through square leg for a single.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Bairstow lets it go. Wide given.
BEATEN! Much-better line from Natarajan. Good length delivery outside off, Bairstow looks to push but misses it due to the seam movement on this one.
WIDE! Length delivery down the leg side, Bairstow looks to flick but misses it. Wide signalled.
Good length delivery on middle, Bairstow defends it off the back foot.
Ben Stokes makes his way out to the middle. T Natarajan will bowl from the other end.

OUT! CASTLED! This is what you call a quality bowler. Despite being hit for three fours in the over, Kumar keeps his cool and has the last laugh. Back of a length ball around off, swinging into Roy who is cramped for room as he leaves a big gap between bat and pad as he looks to defend. He misses and the ball goes onto crash into the off pole. Early breakthrough for India.
FOUR! 3rd boundary in the over! England are off to a flier! Sheer timing on this! Length and around off, Roy clips this through mid-wicket and gets a boundary.
Fuller and around off, Roy pushes it down to long on for a brace.
Length and around leg, Roy looks to clip it to the leg side but gets it off the pads to the leg side. Kumar puts in a muted appeal but the umpire is unmoved.
FOUR! A beautiful check drive! Length and around off, Roy plays a check drive and sends it past the bowler and down to the long off fence for a boundary.
FOUR! What a start for England in the chase! Kumar starts with a length ball around off, Roy leans into the drive and creams it through covers for a boundary.
